_note: Mission notes filed from control, over the thirteen days of the run. kind is LOG or ANOMALY; the science officer's daily findings (SCIENCE) and the health officer's daily activities (HEALTH) are written from the composers in mission control and land here too, one per day and kind. These appear on the landing page's whole-mission fold and in the archive. This is the file to add to during the run when something happens that is not in the schedule.
